tagline: What happens between sessions decides the next one.
description: Sleep and joint support, filtered for Kuwait's import rules as well as our own doctrine. Where a compound cannot lawfully reach Kuwait, we leave the slot empty rather than list something you cannot receive.

copy.unit_basis: Per serving. The types on this page do not share one comparison unit, so each product names its own.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your recovery?
copy.empty_title: Nothing here clears our bar yet.
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 35 recovery products reaching Kuwait and published none. A shelf is whatever clears our listing floor, and nothing in this category does yet — we would rather show you an empty shelf than a padded one.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Products a founder put on the shelf from the database, whatever their score.

types.name: Sleep & Recovery
types.purpose: Getting to sleep after an evening session, without a compound that leaves you flat.
non_negotiables: Melatonin, if present, at 0.5–3 mg — not the 10 mg doses sold as stronger
No ingredient restricted for import into Kuwait
types.shelf_note: Melatonin is regulated differently across the Gulf. Where a product cannot be lawfully imported into Kuwait we exclude it, even if it would otherwise score well.

types.name: Joint Support
types.purpose: Connective tissue under load. A category thick with underdosed formulas.
non_negotiables: Actives at the doses used in the trials that are being cited
